# Memphis Vendor Library

> Memphis Vendor Library is a local consumer publication for people planning weddings, parties, porch styling and grazing tables in the Memphis area. It sets out the questions, cost drivers and checklists to use before booking a vendor.

Publisher: Memphis Vendor Library Editorial Desk. The editorial company that writes, edits and publishes Memphis Vendor Library.
Editorial policy: https://memphisvendorlibrary.com/editorial-standards
Masthead: https://memphisvendorlibrary.com/masthead
Corrections: https://memphisvendorlibrary.com/corrections
Updated: 2026-10-31
